answer: Proof of Stake serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies by requiring capital commitment to validate network transitions. An attacker cannot simply forge identities because each new node demands an economic bridge to the underlying asset. The protocol enforces consensus through a scarcity model as stable as quartz, where the cost of a Sybil attack scales linearly with the total staked value, rendering unauthorized replication prohibitively expensive for malicious actors.
